target.statement: TokenCore achieves token-level AUROC (ROC) 0.6371 on the Grammar dataset.
target.table_ref: Table 1, Grammar column, Token ROC row (TokenCore)
target.dataset: Grammar Correction Dataset (Kaggle grammar-correction; 300 documents, 270 normal and 30 anomalous)

compute.basis: The target only requires BERT-base-uncased embedding of roughly 300 short sentences, construction of a token memory bank from the normal split, and nearest-neighbor scoring; this is a few minutes of CPU inference after installing PyTorch/transformers and downloading BERT.

blockers: The random 50% normal-document train/test split is not fixed with a seed, so the exact AUROC may vary slightly from the table cell.
title: Towards Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection
